supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.13, p~1e-281; dominant driver (full model R2 0.825).
Interaction coef 0.77, p~1e-77, delta R2 0.062; holdout with the interaction (X1,X2,X3,X4,X5,X1:X3) gives test R2 0.876 vs 0.812 for X1,X2,X3 alone, so it generalizes out of sample.
Full regression coef 0.17, p=1.6e-5; small effect.
Full regression coef 0.14, p=4e-4; small effect.

interaction_claims.reason: Interaction p~1e-77, delta R2 0.062, and holdout test R2 improves from 0.812 (no interaction) to 0.876 (with interaction).
Interaction p=0.046 is marginal, delta R2 0.0027 is negligible, and adding X2:X3 to the holdout did not change test R2 (0.876044 vs 0.876082).
Interaction p=0.52, delta R2 0.0002; no evidence.

causal_claims.reason: Observational regression and holdout results show strong association but cannot establish causation.
Strong negative association only; no design to support causal inference.
